The '''Dalastine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Dalastine IV]].<ref name="AD" />
